paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy, measured as Pass@8, for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT. The x-axis represents temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale with a tick label interval of 0.1. The y-axis represents accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy (Pass@8)", spanning from 62.5 to 80.0 on a linear scale with a tick label interval of 2.5. The On-policy RL line is depicted in orange with a solid line style and triangle markers, starting at around 62.5 accuracy at a temperature of 0.1, dropping to 62.5 at 0.2, then rising to approximately 71 at 0.3, followed by a decline to 69 at 0.4, a peak of 71 at 0.5, a decline to 68 at 0.6, a rise to 70 at 0.7, a drop to 67.5 at 0.8, and ending at around 72.5 at a temperature of 1.0. The LUFFY line is shown in red with a solid line style and star markers, beginning at around 74 accuracy at a temperature of 0.1, rising to 78 at 0.2, then decreasing to 76 at 0.3, followed by a rise to 77.5 at 0.4, a peak of 78.75 at 0.5, a decline to 76 at 0.6, a rise to 80 at 0.7, a slight drop to 77.5 at 0.8, a rise to 78 at 0.9, and ending at around 80 at a temperature of 1.0. The SFT line is represented in teal with a solid line style and triangle markers, starting at around 75 accuracy at a temperature of 0.1, remaining steady at 75 at 0.2, then decreasing to 74 at 0.3, followed by a slight decline to 73.75 at 0.4, a decline to 72.5 at 0.5, a peak of 77.5 at 0.6, a sharp decline to 70 at 0.7, a slight drop to 69 at 0.8, a rise to 73.75 at 0.9, and ending at around 74 at a temperature of 1.0.
